output.summary: A bulb-forming perennial herb native to the eastern United States, Mexico, Peru, Uruguay, northeastern Argentina and central Chile. Its whitish flowers usually have a dark reddish midvein but no onion or garlic smell. The bulbs can be gathered year-round and eaten cooked, with a faint garlic flavour.
output.edibilityNote: Bulbs may be gathered year-round and eaten cooked; they have a faint garlic flavour.
